summary: Momentus Inc. filed an 8-K to report a registered direct offering of 1,851,852 shares of Class A common stock at $13.50 per share, raising approximately $25 million in gross proceeds. The offering was conducted under an effective shelf registration statement (Form S-3). Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. The filing includes a 10-day equity issuance blackout and a 30-day ban on variable-rate transactions, plus lock-up agreements from officers and directors. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
